assumptions: N is nonzero and the fixed positive-sign unnormalized complex DFT has a certified Cooley-Tukey or Sande-Tukey mixed-radix factorization N=product N_l.
The factorization, gamma, and exactly represented input are fixed across a family indexed by every positive epsilon.

Every linked stage trace is generated by explicit calls to the model's rounded sine, cosine, multiplication, and addition operations; the computed output is derived from the final rounded stage and permutation.
The scalar operations satisfy Wilkinson's equations (3.1)-(3.2), the absolute sine and cosine model, epsilon>0, and gamma>=0.
The inherited Theorem 1(a) asymptotic bound uses one nonnegative second-order coefficient and one positive radius, both fixed before epsilon, throughout that right neighborhood of zero.
The source model states no separate overflow, underflow, subnormal, NaN, or infinity clauses.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p09_t2_fictional_input_backward_error {n : Nat} [NeZero n] (plan : P09MixedRadixFftPlan n) (gamma : Real) (family : P09AsymptoticFftFamily plan gamma) (forward : P09TheoremOneRmsAsymptotic family) : exists delta : P09PositiveEpsilon -> ZMod n -> Complex, (forall epsilon, p09FamilyFftRoundoffError family epsilon = p09FourierTransform (delta epsilon) and p09ComplexRms (delta epsilon) = p09ComplexRms (p09FamilyFftRoundoffError family epsilon) / Real.sqrt n) and forall epsilon, epsilon.1 <= forward.radius -> p09ComplexRms (delta epsilon) <= epsilon.1 * p09K plan gamma * p09ComplexRms family.input + forward.secondOrderCoeff * epsilon.1^2 / Real.sqrt n and p09ComplexMax (delta epsilon) <= epsilon.1 * Real.sqrt n * p09K plan gamma * p09ComplexRms family.input + forward.secondOrderCoeff * epsilon.1^2
formal_statement.plain_language: For the operational mixed-radix FFT as positive machine precision tends to zero, every exact output roundoff error is the positive-sign Fourier transform of a fictional input perturbation with the paper's exact RMS scaling, and both epsilon-K bounds hold with one epsilon-independent second-order coefficient throughout a neighborhood of zero.

informal_proof: For every positive epsilon, use surjectivity of the fixed complex DFT to choose delta(epsilon) with T delta=e. The exact unnormalized Fourier RMS scaling gives ||delta||RMS=||e||RMS/sqrt(N). On the epsilon-independent neighborhood furnished by Theorem 1, divide its uniform RMS estimate by sqrt(N) for the first bound. For the second, combine ||delta||infinity<=||delta||2=sqrt(N)||delta||RMS=||e||RMS with the same uniform estimate.
informal_statement: The exact fictional-input backward-error construction and both asymptotic norm certificates on printed page 768, tied to an operational complex mixed-radix FFT family and with O(epsilon^2) represented by an epsilon-independent coefficient on a right neighborhood of zero.
